notes: Fixed Mail search results turning back into the whole inbox a few seconds after searching. The Tickets list now opens straight from a saved copy and updates in the background, and closing, assigning or replying no longer reloads the whole list. Closing a ticket now assigns it to whoever closed it. Fixed Closed with a date and an assignee. Added hotkeys for the Tickets filters.
